title: Best Wix Alternatives: Custom Design Without an Agency
summary: Six Wix alternatives compared on real year-one cost, export rights and design control. Every price read from the vendor's own page and dated.
body_markdown: Blink, for two reasons an agency feels immediately. First, the billing shape: there is no per-site plan and no charge for giving a client access, where ten Webflow client sites cost $3,696 a year before any work and grow $300 per new client. Second, what you hand over: on Wix, Squarespace or Webflow the client returns to you for every change, which is either unpaid support or a retainer you have to sell. With Blink the client edits by describing the change, so the handover is final. Webflow remains the stronger choice if you employ a full-time Webflow specialist and sell design craft as the deliverable.
